The Owner grants the Licensee a non-exclusive right to use bays 3 and 4 only in the shared warehouse space, and only for ordinary warehouse use that does not include hazardous storage. The Licensee may access the space daily from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Access codes are personal to the Licensee and may not be shared with anyone else. The Licensee is responsible for using the space safely, following site rules, and leaving the bays in good condition at move-out. If the Licensee causes damage beyond ordinary wear and tear, the Licensee must reimburse the Owner for the repair or replacement cost within 15 days. The Licensee must maintain $1,000,000 in general liability insurance and name the Owner as an additional insured. Either side may end the arrangement on 30 days' notice, and the Owner may suspend access immediately if there is a safety breach. The move-out process must include removal of the Licensee's property and return of all access credentials.
